notes.title: Support for New Languages
notes.content: [p]We’re excited to announce that our latest update brings support for more than 10 languages, making the game more accessible to players worldwide. Dive in and enjoy the experience in your preferred language![/p]

notes.title: Addition of new panels and links for our community
notes.content: In this update, new adjustment menus were added, a fix for the fullscreen window, the inclusion of links to our Discord directly from within the game, and we also added a shortcut command for teleporting to 5 areas of the game.ːsteammockingː
